LAREDO, Texas — Fabian Francisco Ortiz was arrested Wednesday night, October 21, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged second-degree felony charge of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, according to Webb County booking records.

Ortiz was arrested at 10:50 p.m. The booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956 also listed two misdemeanor charges: evading arrest or detention and resisting arrest, search or transport, both Class A misdemeanors. The record did not name an arresting agency.

Bond had not been set on any of the charges as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Fabian Francisco Ortiz is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
